narrative: No clear single catalyst this week. Although headlines such as “US just lost 23,000 jobs” and reports of rising unemployment in San Diego and Oklahoma point to labor-market softness, they do not clearly explain the modest 0.10-point decline in the aggregate unemployment rate, which likely reflects normal statistical movement or broad positioning.
